sourceTileEdgeNote: The AWS mirror readme states that the original bottom-most shared row was removed; the bottom-most sample center in this 3600-row public COG is 41.0002777778, not 41.0.
verification: Architect reopened the normalized crop and compared every sample with its exact integer window in the original, and checked CRS, dtype, nodata, Point interpretation, affine and complete requested sample-center coverage. Independent PIL reading follows separately.
modifications: Integer pixel-aligned crop and lossless DEFLATE re-encoding only. No resampling, value edits, filling, warping, derived terrain or historical features.
productClassification: Modern 30 m digital surface model (surface includes buildings, infrastructure and vegetation); research reference only, not bare-earth terrain, ancient surface, coastline, historical site placement or game authorization.
verticalReference: EGM2008 (EPSG:3855), metres, according to Copernicus product documentation; the downloaded TIFF has no vertical datum tag, so this is documentation attribution rather than a claim based on the file's tags.
horizontalReference: WGS84-G1150 / EPSG:4326, according to Copernicus GLO-30 product documentation; the TIFF CRS tag itself reports EPSG:4326.
normalizationReason: Extended the collector candidate one column east and one row south, using exact original samples, so the actual sample-center coverage contains the entire requested bbox. No extrapolation or sample resampling.

collectorCandidate.status: superseded; its eastern/southern sample centers did not cover the requested bbox

reproduction: Integer source window and source hash above; temporary rasterio/numpy environment only, no dependency added to the project.
